appId.description: ID of the app on the App Store, for example 324684580.

bundleId.description: Bundle ID of the app, for example com.spotify.client.

url.description: Link to the app on the App Store.

developerId.description: ID of the developer on the App Store.

developerUrl.description: Developer page on the App Store.

seller.description: Seller name, usually the developer's legal name.

genre.description: Main category of the app, for example Productivity.

score.description: Average rating of all versions, from 1 to 5.

ratingsCount.description: Number of ratings of all versions.

scoreCurrentVersion.description: Average rating of the current version.

ratingsCountCurrentVersion.description: Number of ratings of the current version.

free.description: True when the app is free to download.

price.description: Price of the app; 0 for free apps.

priceText.description: Price as the App Store shows it, for example Free or $4.99.

releasedAt.description: When the app was first released (ISO date and time).

updatedAt.description: When the current version was released (ISO date and time).

recentChanges.description: What's new in the current version.

minIosVersion.description: Lowest iOS version the app runs on.

languages.description: Languages of the app, as two-letter codes.

iPadSupport.description: True when the app runs on iPad.

gameCenter.description: True when the app uses Game Center.

source.description: How the app was found: search, chart, developer or app (an app ID from the input).

rank.description: Position of the app in the search results or chart, from 1; null for apps found by developer or ID.

searchTerm.description: Search term that found the app; null for other sources.

chart.description: Chart that listed the app, for example top_free or top_grossing; null for other sources.

chartGenre.description: Category of the chart, for example All apps or Games; null for other sources.

developerQuery.description: Developer from the input whose apps were listed; null for other sources.

country.description: Country of the store (ISO code), which sets prices and charts.
